Question: v0.30.3 is released and installed. To take effect, the reposync helper (pid 30809, still the 0.30.2 copy) must restart and synckit must re-list. synckit 0.41.1 has no per-manifest reload: its only reload rebuilds all three engines (reposync, cci, cookiesync) in-process. Which activation should I run?
Options: install + reload (Recommended) | Narrow reload first | Defer activation
